items.title: Software Stocks Are Bouncing Back From AI Fears. BofA Sees More Gains Ahead.
items.summary: Investors have become all too familiar with the fact that the software sector is under pressure as Wall Street worries about the impacts of artificial intelligence.  As AI models become more advanced, fears that those models will eventually replace critical software functions escalate.  Shares of creative software firm  Adobe  for example, have dropped 23% this year while shares of enterprise software company  ServiceNow  have fallen 17%.

items.title: CrowdStrike Sinks 7% Despite Truist Price Target Raise to $245, Palo Alto Networks Falls 5%
items.summary: Truist just raised its CrowdStrike price target by a wide margin and called the cybersecurity setup constructive, yet the stock is bleeding into earnings week anyway. Two smaller names are quietly bucking the selloff, and where the money is hiding tells you something important about where budgets are actually going.
